source_text.body:
Run Mac tasks through Claude computer use
Poster gave Claude dozens of Mac tasks across Finder, Settings, Obsidian and more, creating notes and verifying outputs; dragging and dropdowns still caused problems.
·
Oct 21, 2026
Done with
CU
Claude computer use
What they did
The poster gave Claude Opus 5.5 dozens of Mac tasks across Finder, System Settings, Obsidian, Telegram, Freeform, Preview, and Spotify, then read the logs and reran most tasks with instructions to act through the app like a person. Claude mostly tried terminal commands first, used app-provided numbered controls instead of aiming the mouse, batched several actions before checking results, and asked the person to step in for things like Touch ID or overwriting files.
How it went
It was much faster when it could avoid the screen, with median actions around half a second versus decisions taking over two seconds, but app-driven runs were slower. Failures clustered around dragging, which worked 2 of 4 times, and System Settings drop-downs, where the workaround was wrong every time.
Worth knowing
The main catch was that “do it in the app” made runs slower; the poster says screen inspection caused most latency and errors.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
On my Mac, please do these tasks one by one: [list of tasks in Finder, Settings, notes app]. After each one, verify the result and tell me what you checked. If a drag or dropdown fails, try a keyboard alternative, and pause before deleting or overwriting anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xbq70c/reverse_engineered_claudes_computer_use
